items.name: Fault Detection
items.description: The VCS shall detect and report faults in all critical sensors within 100ms.

items.name: Brake Override
items.description: Brake input shall always override throttle input regardless of system state.

items.name: Limp Mode
items.description: Upon detection of critical fault, VCS shall enter limp mode limiting speed to 30 km/h.

items.name: Redundant Sensors
items.description: Critical sensors (brake pressure, steering angle) shall have redundant inputs with cross-checking.

items.name: Watchdog Timer
items.description: A hardware watchdog shall reset the system if main loop exceeds 10ms execution time.

items.name: Power Loss Handling
items.description: On power loss detection, VCS shall command brakes to safe state within 50ms.
